# 🐞 Bug report ### Command (mark with an `x`) - [ ] new - [ ] build - [x] serve - [ ] test - [ ] e2e - [ ] generate - [ ] add - [ ] update - [ ] lint - [ ] xi18n - [ ] config - [ ] run - [ ] help - [ ] version - [ ] doc ### Description i try to upgrade from angular 8 to angular 9. i found one of my component can not find any pipe. but other component in same module works. and in production build every component can find a pipe normally. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://github.com/mix5003/ng-pipe-not-exists this is from my project that remove not relate code already . if you run `ng serve` and go to `/2/report/financial/profit-and-loss` it works. but if you go to `/2/report/financial/health-index` it will throw error. if you try to copy all code from `FinancialBaseComponent` to `FinancialBusinessHealthComponent` and remove `extends FinancialBaseComponent` it works too. and if you create new project and copy `src/app` to new project and run `ng serve` it works too. ## 🔥 Exception or Error
